_meta.purpose: Independent canonical versification oracle for the Bible Gold Set. Each Bible's per-book chapter tally (derived by span-containment from its frozen gold map) is checked against these externally-established counts, giving map-only marker Bibles an accuracy guarantee that does NOT trust the map's own re-parsed markers.
_meta.scope: protestant_66 counts are universal and externally verifiable (stable since Langton, c.1227) and are strict-gated for every Bible that contains those books. Deuterocanonical chapter divisions vary by tradition (Vulgate folds the Epistle of Jeremiah into Baruch ch.6; KJV keeps it a separate book), so only the well-established KJV-Apocrypha set is strict-gated (idx 219); other traditions' deuterocanon is recorded, not gated, to avoid blessing whatever a map happens to contain.
_meta.book_key: canon._normalize() form: lowercased base name with a leading ordinal where applicable (e.g. '1 samuel', 'song of solomon', 'revelation'). Variant spellings (Vulgate/Old-English) are aliased to these keys by the oracle resolver.
_meta.verse_counts: recorded per-Bible in the map's verse_count and the sources manifest, NOT gated here (KJV vs Vulgate vs Masoretic versification differ).
